title: Need Testers For an "Autonomously" Made Tarkov Clone From Fable 5.2
author: ConclusionOk4815
selftext:
When Fable 5.2 released the other day, I gave it the task of creating a highly realistic tactical shooter in threejs. I fully expected some moderately impressive slop with slightly better blender modeling than Fable 5.1/Opus 5.5. 

It ran for three days straight, and used up 3 usage resets. The end result is incredible, and not what I expected in the slightest.

I'll start with the worst parts:

* Fable cannot model a human body properly. Fingers look warped and faces are terrifying. Everybody looks like they are wearing shoulder pads and have disjointed elbows. No amount of redirection could improve this in a significant way.
* Fable does not want to make decisions for itself. Even though I tried to make it clear that I was giving it a "test" to see how it would perform autonomously, it pretty much refused to do anything without my input. I tried to make this a "true test" by asking for Fable's reccomendation each time. In serious projects this would get incredibely tedious.

Now the Good:

* The level of detail and logic behind the systems is incredible for something made in three days. 
* The sound design, considering AI cannot hear, is phenomenal.

The game itself has two modes:

A Battle Royale Mode on a 16.8km\^2 map with 100 Players, and an Arena style mode with 2 v 2 and 1 v 1.  

There are currently bots in the game (with actually competent AI), but I would really like to test it with real people. If anyone wants to take a look, check out [oblava.io](http://oblava.io)
